examples.name: current-negative-security-outcome
required_behavior: present blocked as the primary security truth
present current only as evidence freshness
do not style current freshness as success

examples.name: expired-positive-recovery-outcome

input.reason: The last restore verification is outside its validity window.

required_behavior: retain historical pass as auditable detail
do not present recovery as currently verified

examples.name: mixed-authority-subject
required_behavior: do not manufacture a combined safe, protected, healthy, or ready verdict

examples.name: rejected-producer-identity-provenance

input.reason: Producer identity provenance was rejected by GoreeCloud Mesh.

required_behavior: present provenance rejection as the controlling transport state
do not present protected as accepted current security truth
retain the rejected claim only as bounded diagnostic detail when authorized

examples.name: redirect-refused-before-evidence-acceptance

transport_detail.diagnostic: Producer refused a redirect while carrying a GoreeCloud Identity service proof.

input.reason: No producer-domain evidence was accepted through the redirected destination.

required_behavior: present the condition as a delivery transport failure
do not infer a Wardveil security state, Privacy Shield privacy state, or Everkeep recovery state from the failed delivery
do not expose service identity proof material or redirect destination credentials in UI diagnostics
